definitions.explanation: Something that must happen and cannot be avoided.

examples.japanese: {必然|ひつぜん}の{結果|けっか}だ。
{必然的|ひつぜんてき}に{起|お}こる。
{偶然|ぐうぜん}か{必然|ひつぜん}か。

notes:
{必然|ひつぜん} refers to something that must happen—inevitability or necessity by natural law or logic.

DERIVED FORMS:
- {必然的|ひつぜんてき}(な): inevitable (na-adjective)
- {必然的|ひつぜんてき}に: inevitably (adverb)
- {必然性|ひつぜんせい}: inevitability, necessity (abstract noun)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {必然|ひつぜん}の{結果|けっか}: an inevitable result
- {必然的|ひつぜんてき}に{起|お}こる: to happen inevitably
- {歴史|れきし}の{必然|ひつぜん}: historical inevitability

CONTRAST:
- {必然|ひつぜん}: inevitability (must happen)
- {偶然|ぐうぜん}: chance, coincidence (happens by accident)
